note: The DECLARED sample the auditor re-executes. This file is the single owner of the sampled set — the auditor and its verifier both read it; neither hardcodes a member. Members are chosen to be runtime-light (no editors, no giant corpora, no dist/ server binary) so the audit can run inside a gate. A member that needs a runtime this machine lacks is declared in declaredBlocked with its reason; an undeclared block FAILS the audit (never silently aged out).

declaredBlocked.reason: Requires .tools/m42-h1-fixture, which .gitignore excludes (line 30: `.tools/`), AND a built dist/lsp/server.js. In a checkout the command dies at realpathSync before writing a record: ENOENT /tmp/<iso>/.tools/m42-h1-fixture. Declared rather than removed from the sample so every audit record keeps naming a gate that cannot reproduce from a clean checkout.

Requires a built dist/ bundle: it runs bin/bb index over its own fixture and then the dist/lsp server. In a checkout the index command exits 1 (no build output), so no fresh record is produced. Declared for the same reason as m42/H1.
